name: force-full-scan-consults-store
body: Coordinator::force_full_scan calls cmd_scan without --force: no live session exists at that point, so only the derived-artifact discard is needed, and its scan still consults the shared fact store and may warm-reuse it. Limit: an abort whose phantom projection warm reuse would reproduce is not healed by this rebuild. Upgrade to pass --force there if a phantom projection is ever observed to survive a warm reuse after an abort.
